sections.title: About this guide
data: Air Station Atlantic City flies helicopters from the FAA's technical center at the Atlantic City airport. The home count comes from the Coast Guard's housing map; the address comes from the air station's inbound personnel page, read through search results.
Ask your sponsor before you move.

sections.title: Coast Guard Housing
data: The Coast Guard's housing map lists 11 active homes at an Absecon housing site, about 10 road miles from the air station (public maps). Most families rent in the surrounding towns on BAH; ask the air station for the local housing officer.

In the Coast Guard, assignment to Coast Guard housing is generally mandatory when a home is available, and BAH starts only after the housing office releases you to rent in town. Ask your sponsor for the local housing officer before you look at rentals.
